## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care completed 110 captures during May 2025. Activity was recorded for the month as part of routine site monitoring. The service should continue to maintain the current recording process so that capture volumes and subsequent grading outcomes remain available for review. Any operational concerns affecting image capture should be noted at the time they occur and followed up through the usual local arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 6 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 5.5. This result should be reviewed by the site team to identify any recurring causes and to support improvement in image acquisition. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Staff should also ensure that equipment concerns are recorded clearly and escalated through the appropriate route.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the expected operational timeframe for the reporting period. The site should continue to monitor the interval between capture and grading, alongside image quality and referral outcomes, as part of routine service oversight.
